have key : List.Sublist.below (motive := motive) t ∧ motive a a_1 t := by induction t <;> refine (fun hb => ⟨hb, h _ _ _ hb⟩) ?_ <;> constructor <;> (try exact ‹_ ∧ _›.1) <;> (try exact ‹_ ∧ _›.2)

have key : List.Sublist.below (motive := motive) t ∧ motive a a_1 t := by induction t with | slnil => exact ⟨.slnil, h _ _ _ .slnil⟩ | cons x s ih => exact ⟨.cons x ih.1 ih.2, h _ _ _ (.cons x ih.1 ih.2)⟩ | cons₂ x s ih => exact ⟨.cons₂ x ih.1 ih.2, h _ _ _ (.cons₂ x ih.1 ih.2)⟩
have key : List.Sublist.below (motive := motive) t ∧ motive a a_1 t := by induction t <;> grind [List.Sublist.below.slnil, List.Sublist.below.cons, List.Sublist.below.cons₂]
